title: EFTA02810827: What Jorge Amador’s Forensic Report Actually Found

primary_document.author: Jorge Amador
primary_document.case: Government of the United States Virgin Islands v. JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., No. 1:22-cv-10904-JSR

supporting_sources.title: Senate Finance staff memorandum on JPMorgan and Epstein

evidence_boundaries: The Amador report is an expert report prepared for contested civil litigation.
Expert characterizations of suspiciousness or legitimate business purpose are not judicial findings.
Transaction existence, amount, date, sender, and recipient should be validated against underlying bank records where available.
GAH does not infer redacted report content.
